Subject: Workshop Schedule Update

Dear Participants,

Please note a change to the schedule for our upcoming workshop. Registration will still begin at 8:45 a.m. as originally planned, but the practical session has been moved to the afternoon. The morning program will now include introductory presentations and group discussions.

Lunch will be provided for all participants, so no separate arrangements are necessary. Please remember to bring your laptop, as it will be required for the practical activities later in the day.

Thank you for your understanding, and we look forward to welcoming you to the workshop.

Kind regards,

The Workshop Team
task: Write a professional email explaining a fictional workshop schedule change: the practical session moves to the afternoon, registration remains at 8:45, lunch is included, and participants should bring laptops.
